mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_pet_profile (user_id, level, satiety, clean_value, energy_value, growth_value) VALUES (#{userId}, 1, 60, 60, 60, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_pet_profile SET satiety = LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, satiety + #{satietyDelta})), clean_value = LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, clean_value + #{cleanDelta})), energy_value = LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, energy_value + #{energyDelta})), growth_value = growth_value + #{growthDelta}, level = 1 + FLOOR((growth_value + #{growthDelta}) / 100), update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE sq_pet_profile SET growth_value = growth_value + #{growthDelta}, level = 1 + FLOOR((growth_value + #{growthDelta}) / 100), update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT a.user_id, a.coin, a.point, a.experience, p.level AS pet_level, p.satiety AS pet_satiety, p.clean_value AS pet_clean_value, p.energy_value AS pet_energy_value, p.growth_value AS pet_growth_value FROM sq_user_asset a JOIN sq_pet_profile p ON p.user_id = a.user_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId}
